summary: Proposal context for moving Cartographer implementation from prose-only skill guidance into a harness-integrated command/tool wrapper. Key evidence: sanitized tanstack-dashboard session analysis shows sunset-pathfinder state tooling was available but no cartographer_state/state-init/compact-generate/state-resume calls occurred, no .cartographer state was created, and the session finalized with later phases pending. Design direction: center Cartographer around deterministic enforceable workflow tools instead of prose-only skills. Add cartographer_transition for explicit lifecycle gates from proposal draft to implemented, including human request/approve/reject receipts with deterministic approver identity resolution from optional gitignored .cartographer/config.toml, git user.name, or system username; wrapper-first implement command/tool; deterministic subagent handoff wrapper for auditor/compass gates and report capture; proposal init/finalize wrappers; fact/source append wrappers; plan graph generation/finalize wrappers; plan status/checkoff and validation-completion wrappers; context-pack create/update; generic non-validation receipt append; ADR metadata sync; explicit reliability evaluation before patching/replacing the generic subagents dependency with a native Pi SDK runner; mandatory state-init/state-validate; wrapper-controlled next_action/working_set/validation refs; compact-generate/state-resume milestones; Pi extension hooks for commands, context/tool-call guards, and session compaction bridging; pending-phase finalization guard; preserve .plan authority, deterministic receipts, and read-only auditor gates.

Plan context for implementing deterministic Cartographer workflow enforcement. Proposal is user-approved. Plan has 8 phases: P0 shared contracts/runtime, P1 receipts/context/transition tools, P2 proposal/fact wrappers, P3 plan/status/validation wrappers, P4 implement runner/harness guards, P5 subagent handoff wrapper, P6 docs/skill integration, P7 final validation/ADR. Core lifecycle gates require deterministic prerequisites plus human approval receipts before moving proposal->plan, plan->implementation, and final implementation->implemented. Normal implementation phases advance automatically after deterministic validation/audit/context/state prerequisites pass; only explicitly human-gated phases stop for approval. Open questions are resolved: expose hyphenated CLI aliases plus underscored tools; require explicit approver in CI/non-interactive approval; use hybrid edit guardrails; evaluate current subagent wrapper, then other extensions, then native runner only if needed. .plan remains authoritative; .cartographer remains execution/resume state.

P0 completed shared workflow contracts/runtime foundation. Added skills/plan/scripts/cartographer_workflow.ts with lifecycle states, transition gates, receipt kinds, gate prerequisites, approval metadata, deterministic approver resolution from explicit input, .cartographer/config.toml, git user.name, then system username, secret-like label rejection, minimal TOML parsing, atomic JSON/JSONL helpers, and temp-root workflow fixture builder. Added tests/cartographer_workflow.test.ts for contracts, config parsing, approver fallback order, atomic helpers, and temp-root fixtures. Updated .gitignore for .cartographer/config.toml and package check:scripts to parse the new script.

P1 implemented deterministic receipt/context-pack/transition wrappers and fixed fallback review blockers: transition-advance now honors --gate, prerequisites accept validation-receipt/auditor-receipt shapes, context packs enforce bounds/artifact/receipt safety, and tests cover all receipt kinds plus CLI advance gate behavior. P2 completed deterministic proposal and fact wrappers. cartographer_workflow.ts now supports proposal-init, proposal-adr-sync, proposal-finalize, fact-add-source, fact-add-fact, and fact-support-fact with safe artifact initialization, source-backed fact upserts, ADR metadata sync, fact citation checks, sanitized evidence checks, auditor report enforcement, validate-topic/context/audit-gated finalization, and extension registrations. Tests cover no-truncation init, supported_by enforcement, ADR sync, finalize gates, CLI aliases, and tool registration.
